verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy documents cost tracking that tracks spend for keys, users, and teams across 100+ LLMs, plus tag-based spend tracking, all centralized in a self-hosted gateway with an admin UI. That delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-model spend breakdowns, detail on how the admin UI presents spend reports, independent or hands-on corroboration that cross-provider spend tracking works as claimed.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: Track spend for keys, users, and teams across 100+ LLMs.
Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys, cost tracking, and an admin UI
pass tags to track spend by tags
